eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 12:56 AM on AUG 14, 2023 Effective until 10:56 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert for Mary Ann Le Beau has been canceled as she has been found safe by the Phoenix Police Department. For further information please contact the Phoenix Police Department. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
